This article compares the incidence of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] among prevalent patients with atrial fibrillation, categorized by their [[antikoagulationsbehandling]] status, across two reporting periods documented in the [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] reports. The data highlights the safety profiles of different treatment groups, specifically comparing [[doac|DOAC]], [[marevan]], combination therapy, and no anticoagulant treatment.

In the 2024 report, the highest rate of intracranial bleeding was observed in patients receiving both DOAC and Marevan, at 1.50% (16 out of 1,069 patients) [^src1]. The lowest rate was among those receiving neither DOAC nor Marevan, at 0.45% (123 out of 27,331 patients) [^src1]. Notably, the 2024 data shows identical figures for the "AK-behandling" and "DOAC" categories, both reporting 541 bleeding events out of 102,215 patients (0.53%) [^src1]. 

By the 2025 report, the total prevalent patient population grew, and the overall intracranial bleeding rate increased slightly from 0.53% to 0.56% [^src2]. The combination of both DOAC and Marevan saw a significant drop in bleeding incidence to 0.62% (5 events), though it remained one of the higher-risk categories alongside Marevan monotherapy, which had a 0.63% bleeding rate (32 events) [^src2]. The lowest bleeding rate in the 2025 data was again among patients on neither DOAC nor Marevan, at 0.52% [^src2]. A notable outlier in the 2025 table is the DOAC row, which is entirely blank, suggesting a change in reporting structure or data availability for that specific category compared to the 2024 report [^src2]. Furthermore, the number of patients treated with Marevan or a combination of both drugs decreased between the two reports, while the absolute number of bleeding events in the untreated (neither DOAC nor Marevan) group rose from 123 to 138 [^src1] [^src2].

- "Indikator 4a måler andelen af patienter med atrieflimren, med indikation for antikoagulationsbehandling, der modtager behandling (ud af den population hvor det er indiceret)" — see [[quality-indicator-definition|Quality Indicator Definition]] ([[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]]) [^src28]
- "For indikator 4a er tælleren patienter i nævneren, som modtager behandling, dvs. der er indløst mindst én recept i perioden 90 dage før til 90 dage efter 1, 2 og 5-års dagen for diagnosedatoen for atrieflimren" — see [[quality-indicator-definition|Quality Indicator Definition]] ([[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]]) [^src28]
- "Indikator 4b måler andelen af patienter med atrieflimren i behandling med direkte orale antikoagulantia (DOAC) med mindst 1 måling af P-creatinin årligt" — see [[quality-indicator-definition|Quality Indicator Definition]] ([[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]]) [^src28]
- "Indikator 5 måler incidens af iskæmisk apopleksi blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren" — see [[quality-indicator-definition|Quality Indicator Definition]] ([[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]]) [^src28]
- "Indikator 6 måler incidens af intrakraniel blødning blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren" — see [[quality-indicator-definition|Quality Indicator Definition]] ([[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]]) [^src28]
- "Indikator 7 måler incidens af alvorlig blødning (tillempede International Society of Thrombosis and Hemostasis (ISTH) kriterier) blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren" — see [[quality-indicator-definition|Quality Indicator Definition]] ([[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]]) [^src28]
- "Indikator 8 måler andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren som får et struktureret undervisningsprogram indenfor 1 år efter diagnosen er stillet" — see [[quality-indicator-definition|Quality Indicator Definition]] ([[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]]) [^src28]
